mission: Move repo-cli and its tests off hand-rolled gh and git spawning onto @beep/github, @beep/git and @beep/commands, extending the kits where they lack the feature

completionGate.statement: Not achieved until this goal's work ships as a PR driven to mergeable via /yeet (bun run beep yeet: repair -> verify -> publish --pr -> monitor).

stopConditions: Required source files are missing or materially contradictory.
Any spend: purchases, paid services, quota top-ups or plan changes need the operator.
The same blocker repeats after reasonable investigation.

opsScripts.purpose: W0 differential: the frozen merge-base --is-ancestor probes and worktree prune/remove captures compared with Git.isAncestor, Git.worktreePrune and Git.worktreeRemove over scratch repositories, including a shallow clone and a non-repository.

W1a differential: the frozen GitExec typed readers (rev-parse, merge-base, ls-tree, name-status renames, dirty-path collectors, current branch) compared with their Git-backed replacements over scratch repositories with branched history, renames at and below 50%, a spaced path, a deletion, dirty paths, an unknown ref, an option-like ref and a non-repository.

W1b differential: the frozen Yeet git bodies (base-ref refresh with and without an origin remote, current commit sha on a branch, detached and unborn, the is-ancestor probes, and the head-install preflight's worktree add, remove --force and prune) compared with their Git-backed replacements over scratch repositories with a bare origin carrying a tag, an option-like ref and a non-repository.

W2 differential: the frozen dirty-axis readers (ChangedFiles probes and base range, the lockfile pathspec, the ResidueReap, TmpfsReap and Fleet status reads, the Worktree listing parser, Fleet's origin and common-dir probes, the CiLane, ChangesetStatus, Codex Security, SessionLedger and rev-parse one-liners) compared with their Git-backed replacements over scratch repositories with a dirty worktree (staged, unstaged, untracked, a nested untracked directory, a staged rename, a non-ASCII path, a path with a space), a branched history with a rename and a deletion, diff-filter and pathspec scopes, linked and locked worktrees, a detached head, an unborn repository and a non-repository.

W2b differential: the frozen Yeet Settle/ProofShadow/Sweep/Retire/MergedPreview/ReadyGate/PullRequest/Status git bodies, the Library inventory commit read and the ai-metrics ls-files read compared with their Git-backed replacements over scratch repositories with a bare origin, a linked worktree, a detached HEAD, a dirty tree, a spaced and a non-ASCII path, a lockfile change, merged, upstream-only and unpushed branches, a non-fast-forward push, an unmerged index and a non-repository, plus the CommandProbe adapter spawn-failure case.

W3 differential: the frozen pre-W3 Reviewer and Ci GitHub bodies (ops/frozen-w3: the gh/op secret reads and origin lookup, the gh api reader with its transient retry, the runner-loss reads and rerun, the governance client, ruleset administration and the merge gate, the HttpClient reviewer publishing service and App token cache) compared with their @beep/github and @beep/commands replacements over one recorded fixture table, served to the old bodies by a fake gh/op (jq projections applied with the real jq) and to the new ones through the transport fetch.
